_meta.description: Published/tutorial perfumery formulas (complete accords and compositions) with ingredients, relative parts, dilution notes, note pyramids and derived olfactory descriptions, for the Perfumista engine.
sources: Perfumer's Apprentice 'Key Accord' formula PDFs (shop.perfumersapprentice.com/Documents/KeyAccordFormulas/*.pdf) - 42 Givaudan/IFF educational accords, extracted from the PDF text layer
IFF 'Demonstration Formulas Introducing Karmawood/Bergamal' (c)2014, hosted on Pell Wall CDN, retrieved via Wayback Machine - 9 accords
Olfactorian.com community formula database (olfactorian.com/formulas/*) - accords with exact parts/CAS
The Good Scents Company demo formulas (thegoodscentscompany.com/demos)
Ayala Moriel SmellyBlog (DIY Eau de Cologne)
I Dream of Perfume / Mandy Aftel amber accord
_meta.parts_note: 'parts' is a relative weight. Perfumer's Apprentice & Olfactorian formulas are normalized to /1000 (KILO column). Pell Wall/IFF demo formulas are /100. Ayala cologne parts are drops. A 'dilution' field means that ingredient is dosed as a pre-dilution (e.g. '10% in DPG'). Materials with very large parts and note 'solvent/carrier/diluent' (DPG, MCT, IPM, benzyl benzoate, DOA, PG) are the diluent, not odorants.
caveats: The 42 Perfumer's Apprentice accords are documented (parts verified: each sums to ~1000). A few PDFs had OCR row-ordering glitches where an ingredient name printed away from its number; these are annotated in per-ingredient 'note' or 'source_note' and the affected formula (Floral Natural) is flagged partial.
These are EDUCATIONAL/DEMONSTRATION accords built to showcase captive materials (Givaudan/IFF) - not commercial fine-fragrance formulas, which houses never publish.

smells_like / what_it_does for the PA accords are DERIVED from the documented materials and known material characters (only Amber, Rose and Leather have manufacturer-supplied scent descriptions, quoted as such); treat descriptions as expert interpretation, not source-quoted, except where noted.
Olfactorian.com is a community/enthusiast database (medium-authority); its formulas give exact parts and CAS but originality/accuracy is community-sourced.

Pell Wall/IFF demo formulas each exist in a '(-)' base and '(+)' version; the encoded parts use the '(+)' (with featured material) version and the diluent note records both. Source PDF is only reachable via the Wayback Machine URL given (the live S3 object returns 403).

Vanilla 10 (Good Scents) is flagged partial: it shares a multi-formula aggregate page with the Chocolate Accord and its exact rows on that page were not independently re-verified (Chocolate was verified).
CAS numbers are only included where the source provided them; otherwise null. No CAS, parts or ingredients were invented.

formulas.name: Amber Key Accord (Givaudan)

ingredients.note: ingredient name printed at end of PDF; matches the 200 row

formulas.smells_like: A modern, fresh amber with deep, warm and musky tones (per Givaudan's own description); soft ambergris-woody rather than sweet-oriental.
formulas.what_it_does: Galaxolide + Exaltolide + Velvione build a clean musky bed; Ambroxan and Okoumal give the dry-ambergris/woody-amber lift; Benzoin adds balsamic warmth; Dihydro ionone beta and Geraniol soften and round the top.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Amberspice Key Accord (Natural)
formulas.smells_like: Warm balsamic-spicy amber: sweet vanillic-heliotrope powder over resinous labdanum and earthy patchouli, brightened by bergamot.
formulas.what_it_does: All-natural amber: Labdanum + patchouli + amyris/cedar form the resinous woody base; vanillin/ethyl vanillin/heliotropine give sweet powdery amber; bergamot/petitgrain/ylang lift the top. Heavily diluted in MCT (66%).
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Carnation Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Classic spicy carnation: clove-like eugenol warmth over a rosy phenyl-ethyl body with a soft musky-woody drydown.
formulas.what_it_does: Eugenol is the clove-carnation signature; Phenyl ethyl alcohol + Benzyl salicylate give the rosy floral body and fixation; Nutmeg and the Ylang accord add spicy-floral complexity; Methyl diantilis/laitone add clove-vanilla creaminess.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Chypre Key Accord (Natural)
formulas.smells_like: A soft natural chypre: bright bergamot-citrus top, floral-violet heart, drying to earthy patchouli-vetiver with powdery sweetness (moss-free/IFRA-friendly).
formulas.what_it_does: Bergamot leads the classic chypre top; patchouli + vetiver + sandalwood replace oakmoss as the earthy-woody base; alpha ionone and heliotropine add the violet-powder facet; jasmine/ylang give the floral heart. Strongly diluted in MCT (88%).
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Cognac Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches 0.199 row

formulas.smells_like: Boozy brandy/cognac: winey-fruity davana and fatty ethyl esters over a fermented, slightly mossy-ambery base; smells like aged spirit and fruit.
formulas.what_it_does: Cognac oil, ethyl caprate and the small esters (ethyl acetate/propionate) give the fatty-fermented cognac character; Whiskey lactone adds oaky-coconut barrel notes; Davana lends the winey fruit; Veramoss/Fixamber/Ambrocenide fix and add moss-amber depth. ~82% IPM diluent.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Cologne Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Fresh modern eau de cologne: sparkling citrus-lavender freshness (dihydro myrcenol/linalyl acetate) over a clean floral-musky base.
formulas.what_it_does: Dihydro myrcenol + linalyl acetate give the bright fresh-citrus-lavender cologne signature; Geranyl acetate/Aurantiol/Peonile add orange-blossom floralcy; Ethylene brassylate + Exaltolide provide the clean musky fixative base.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Floral Key Accord (Natural)

ingredients.note: OCR mapped this material to the 0.997 row
OCR: '0.01 10% ALC' at 10g scale; parts approximate

formulas.smells_like: A soft all-natural floral bouquet dominated by rosy geranium with jasmine, rose and ylang, a green violet-leaf edge and herbal lavender-chamomile lift.
formulas.what_it_does: Geranium is the rosy-floral backbone (~53 parts of the 74-part concentrate); rose/jasmine/ylang absolutes add true-floral depth; violet leaf gives a green top; lavender/chamomile herbal freshness. Very dilute (~93% MCT).
formulas.source_note: PDF OCR mis-ordered two rows (Jasmine 10%ALC line and an unlabeled 0.997 row); parts for jasmine/ylang are best-effort and flagged partial.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Fougere Key Accord (Natural)

ingredients.note: one of two 1.998 rows; name printed at end of PDF
name printed at end of PDF

formulas.smells_like: A natural fougere: herbal lavandin-basil and citrus top over rosy geranium, drying to sweet hay/heliotrope-vanilla warmth with earthy vetiver.
formulas.what_it_does: Lavandin/basil give the aromatic fern top; heliotropine + ethyl vanillin + benzoin replace coumarin/tonka for the sweet-hay base; vetiver adds earthiness; bergamot/orange brighten. ~82% MCT diluent.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Gardenia Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Creamy white gardenia: green-fruity tuberose-like top (Viridine/benzyl acetate) over a rosy PEA body with a soft sandalwood-vanilla base and indolic depth.
formulas.what_it_does: Phenyl ethyl alcohol is the floral base; Methyl anthranilate + Indolene give the heady indolic-orange-flower gardenia signature; Viridine adds green hyacinth; Javanol/methyl laitone bring creamy sandalwood; heliotropine/ethyl vanillin soften.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Gin Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Crisp gin & tonic: juniper-like coniferous cypress with coriander-spice and a lime-citrus lift; dry and boozy.
formulas.what_it_does: Cypress stands in for the piney juniper of gin; coriander seed gives the classic gin botanical spice; lime the citrus; rum ether a boozy nuance. Extremely dilute (~96% DOA) — a tincture-strength accord.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Green Leaf Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Sharp cut-grass green: crushed-leaf freshness (cis-3-hexenol) with a galbanum-tomato edge (Stemone) over a soft floral-woody base.
formulas.what_it_does: cis-3-hexenol + its acetate are the crushed-green-leaf signature; Stemone adds a sharp herbal-tomato-leaf facet; Styrallyl acetate a gardenia-green top; Hexyl salicylate + PEA + tetrahydro linalool give a soft floral body so the green reads natural, not raw.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Hyacinth Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches 199.1 row

formulas.smells_like: Green watery hyacinth: sharp galbanum-green top with a cool cyclamen/lily muguet facet over a rosy phenyl-ethyl floral body; slightly indolic and spicy.
formulas.what_it_does: Phenyl ethyl alcohol is the rosy base; Galbanum gives the signature green hyacinth bite; Cyclamen aldehyde + Lilial add the cool watery lily-of-the-valley facet; Indole a narcotic depth; Eugenol a spicy warmth.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Iris Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Powdery orris: violet-ionone rooty powder over a soft rosy floral body with a creamy sandalwood-musk woody base; elegant and cosmetic.
formulas.what_it_does: Alpha ionone (white coeur) is the violet-iris powder core; Verdox/Florocyclene/Iso E Super + the Sandalwood accord give the dry-rooty woody drydown; PEA/citronellol/peonile add rose; Okoumal/Velvione fix. ~26% DPG.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Jasmine Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Radiant fresh jasmine: airy transparent jasmine (Hedione) with a fruity-banana benzyl-acetate top and a warm indolic, slightly animalic-narcotic heart.
formulas.what_it_does: Benzyl acetate + Hedione (~80% of the accord together) are the classic jasmine skeleton — benzyl acetate the fruity-floral punch, Hedione the diffusive transparent jasmine; Indolene/para-cresyl acetate add indolic-animalic realism; Ebanol/hexyl salicylate soften.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Leather Key Accord (Givaudan)
formulas.smells_like: A light, fresh and elegant leather (per Givaudan's description): dry saffron-leather (Safraleine) with a smoky styrax edge and a smooth sandalwood-amber base — not a heavy tar leather.
formulas.what_it_does: Safraleine is the dominant modern leather-saffron note; Styrax + Castoreum + Pharaone add the smoky-animalic realism; Ebanol/Okoumal give a woody-ambery smoothness; Hercolyn D fixes and rounds. Confirmed identical on olfactorian.com mirror.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Madeleine Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches 100 row

formulas.smells_like: Warm baked cake: buttery vanilla-caramel sponge (madeleine) with a toasty-nutty crust note and creamy coconut-lactonic softness.
formulas.what_it_does: Maltol + ethyl maltol give caramel/cotton-candy; Vanillin + ethyl vanillin the vanilla; Acetyl pyrazine the toasted-baked crust; Acetanisole a sweet hawthorn nuance; Methyl laitone (a lactone) the buttery-creamy body.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Marine & Ozone Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Fresh sea-breeze aquatic: watermelon-ozone Calone freshness with an airy floral-transparent Hedione heart over a clean musky-ambergris base.
formulas.what_it_does: Calone 1951 is the iconic marine/watermelon-ozone note; Helional adds a watery-green ozonic facet; Hedione + ethyl linalool give airy freshness; Galaxolide/Habanolide/Ambroxan/Iso E Super build the clean woody-musky-salty base.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Mimosa Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Soft powdery mimosa: sweet almond-anisic powder (anisic aldehyde/heliotropine) with a green-cucumber freshness and a delicate honeyed-floral body.
formulas.what_it_does: Anisic aldehyde + heliotropine give the powdery-almond mimosa signature; Dihydro ionone beta adds a woody-violet powder; Nonadienal + Viridine a green-cucumber-leaf top; Terpineol/Peonile/Florhydral the floral-muguet body.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Muguet (Lily of the Valley) Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Fresh dewy lily-of-the-valley: cool watery muguet (Cyclamen aldehyde/Florhydral) with a green cut-stem top over a soft rosy floral body.
formulas.what_it_does: Cyclamen aldehyde + Florhydral are the classic muguet aldehydes giving the cool green-floral lily character; PEA + Hedione + ethyl linalool the fresh floral body; cis-3-hexenol adds a green dewy top; Indolene a touch of naturalness.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Orange Flower (Neroli) Key Accord

ingredients.note: diluent/solvent; name printed at end of PDF, matches one 150 row

formulas.smells_like: Bittersweet orange blossom / neroli: green-petitgrain top over a honeyed orange-flower floral heart with a soft musky-methyl-anthranilate base.
formulas.what_it_does: Oranger crystals + Aurantiol (a methyl-anthranilate Schiff base) give the orange-flower/neroli signature; Petitgrain + Linalool the fresh green-bitter top; Terpineol/Geraniol/PEA floral body; Galaxolide musky fixation.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Peach Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Juicy ripe peach: creamy lactonic peach flesh (gamma decalactone) with a fruity-estery top and a soft fuzzy-skin violet-woody nuance.
formulas.what_it_does: Gamma decalactone is the peach-skin lactone core; the fruity esters (ethyl-2-methyl butyrate etc.) give juicy bite; Damascone beta + Ionone beta add a rosy-violet fruity depth; Methyl laitone/Ebanol a creamy woody base. ~20% DPG.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Pear Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Soft juicy pear: fresh green-fruity pear (Fructone/hexyl acetate) with a lactonic sweetness over a clean woody-musky base.
formulas.what_it_does: Fructone gives the green apple-pear fruitiness; Hexyl acetate + Neryl acetate the juicy fresh-pear top; Aldehyde C-14 a soft lactonic-peach nuance; Verdox + Galaxolide + brassylate the woody-musky base that makes it wearable (Galaxolide is half the formula).
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Pina Colada Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Tropical pina colada cocktail: juicy pineapple (allyl caproate) with creamy coconut (aldehyde C-18) and a sweet vanilla-rum sweetness.
formulas.what_it_does: Allyl caproate is the pineapple note; Aldehyde C-18 (gamma nonalactone) + Methyl laitone give the creamy coconut/lactonic body; Vanillin/ethyl maltol add sweet rum-cocktail warmth; Aldehyde C-16 a candied strawberry lift.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Plumeria Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Rich tropical frangipani (plumeria): heady creamy-fruity white floral with banana-ylang facets, a lactonic peach-coconut softness and an anisic-powdery sweetness.
formulas.what_it_does: Benzyl salicylate + benzyl alcohol + nerolidol build the soft heavy floral base; ylang/jasmone/benzyl acetate the tropical white-floral heart; gamma dodecalactone/jasmolactone add creamy fruit; anisic aldehyde/anisyl alcohol powdery sweetness; indole naturalistic depth.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Red Apple Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Crisp red apple: sweet-juicy estery apple (Fructone/butyrates) with a fresh green skin note over a clean woody-musky base.
formulas.what_it_does: Fructone + the fruity esters give the sweet apple flesh; Cyclal C/Isocyclocitral a green apple-peel bite; Nectaryl a peachy-apricot roundness; Verdox + Galaxolide + dihydro myrcenol the fresh woody-musky base.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Red Fruit Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Sweet jammy red berries: candied strawberry-raspberry (aldehyde C-16 / raspberry ketone) with a soft violet-woody roundness.
formulas.what_it_does: Aldehyde C-16 gives the candied strawberry; Raspberry ketone the jammy raspberry; Isoraldeine (methyl ionone) a violet-woody softness that keeps it from being purely candy; Peonile/Nectaryl a rosy-peachy fruit body; Anisyl acetate a sweet balsamic lift.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Rose Key Accord (Givaudan)
formulas.smells_like: A very elegant, delicate yet sophisticated rose (per Givaudan): fresh dewy-metallic rose petal (rose oxide) with a sweet honeyed-fruity body and soft green nuance.
formulas.what_it_does: Citronellol + Geranyl acetate + Peonile are the classic rosy backbone; Rose oxide gives the sharp fresh green-metallic petal top; Damascone delta a fruity-rose depth; Phenyl ethyl phenyl acetate a honeyed sweetness; Undecavertol a green watery lift. Confirmed by community reproductions.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Salt (Clean) Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Clean mineral 'salt': a dry transparent woody-musky skin scent (Iso E Super dominant) with a subtle salty-mineral, peppery-green facet.
formulas.what_it_does: Iso E Super (~69%) gives the transparent cedar-woody 'skin' base; Cashmeran adds a musky-mineral warmth; Cedrol/Fixolide/Boisambrene reinforce the dry woody-amber; tiny doses of cumin/pepper/Liffarome suggest a salty-sweaty mineral nuance; bergamot lifts.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Salt (Dry) Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Dry savory-mineral 'salt': a transparent Hedione base carrying herbal-vegetal (celery, carrot seed, parsley), cumin-sweaty and peppery facets that read as salty skin.
formulas.what_it_does: Hedione (~94%) is the airy transparent carrier; the vegetal-herbal trace materials (celery seed, carrot seed, parsley, cumin, pepper) build a savory-sweaty-mineral impression of salt/skin; Cashmeran + coumarin add a soft musky-sweet ground.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Sandalwood Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Creamy sandalwood: smooth milky-woody sandal (Javanol/Ebanol) with a soft violet-woody warmth and an earthy patchouli-guaiac undertone.
formulas.what_it_does: Javanol + Ebanol are the two premium sandalwood synthetics giving the creamy-milky sandal character; Vertofix + guaiacwood add a dry-woody amber depth; Dihydro ionone beta a violet-woody softness; patchouli a natural earthy anchor.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Seaweed Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches one 5 row

formulas.smells_like: Briny green seaweed: a wet marine-algae, mossy-vegetal accord with an earthy vetiver-patchouli undertone; smells of ocean plants and salt spray.
formulas.what_it_does: Aquaflor/Maritima/Adoxal give the wet marine-oceanic facet; Veramoss + oakmoss-type + mate the mossy-green seaweed character; vetiver/patchouli the earthy anchor. ~85% benzyl benzoate diluent.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Smoke Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches one 9.994 row
name printed at end of PDF; matches 19.987 row

formulas.smells_like: Dry campfire smoke: phenolic-tarry guaiacol smoke over a resinous frankincense and dry cedar/vetiver woody base; leathery-incense character.
formulas.what_it_does: Guaiacol is the phenolic woodsmoke note; Cedryl acetate + cedarwood + Vertofix + guaiacwood give the dry burnt-wood base; Frankincense adds resinous incense; Pyralone/Safraleine a leathery smokiness; vetiver/patchouli earthy depth. ~71% benzyl benzoate.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Spice Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches leading 5 row

formulas.smells_like: Warm dry spice cabinet: peppery-nutmeg-allspice warmth over a woody-leathery base with a soft coumarin sweetness.
formulas.what_it_does: Allspice + nutmeg + black pepper are the dominant spice trio; Vertofix gives a dry-woody amber base; Safraleine/Pyralone add a leathery-saffron edge; Coumarin a hay-sweet rounding; clary sage a herbal lift.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Tobacco Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Sweet pipe tobacco: warm honeyed-dried-leaf tobacco (damascenone/clary sage) with vanilla-hay sweetness and a woody-ambery base.
formulas.what_it_does: Dihydro ionone beta + clary sage + damascenone build the dried-tobacco-leaf character; Vanillin + coumarin-like methyl laitone add the sweet honeyed hay; Okoumal/cedarwood/Ebanol the woody-amber base; Safraleine a leathery facet.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Tomato Leaf Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches 160 row

formulas.smells_like: Sharp green tomato vine: pungent crushed tomato-leaf (Stemone/Cyclal C) with a lemony-green top and a fresh muguet-floral underlay.
formulas.what_it_does: Stemone + Cyclal C (Triplal) give the pungent tomato-leaf/stem character; cis-3-hexenol the crushed-green-leaf; Citral/Lemonile a lemony-green lift; Florosa/hexyl salicylate a soft floral base to keep it wearable.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Tonka Bean Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Sweet hay-almond tonka: coumarinic new-mown-hay warmth with almond-heliotrope powder, vanilla and a creamy coconut-lactone softness.
formulas.what_it_does: Coumarin (~20%) is the hay/tonka core; Bicyclononalactone (~20%) adds a creamy coconut-lactonic body; Tonka absolutes reinforce; Anisic aldehyde/heliotropine the almond-powder; ethyl vanillin/benzoin the sweet balsamic-vanilla. ~58% benzyl benzoate.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Tulip Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Fresh green tulip: an airy watery-green floral (Hedione/Florosa) with a lemony-green top and a soft clean-musk base; delicate and transparent.
formulas.what_it_does: Hedione + Habanolide (together ~64%) give the airy floral-musk transparency; Florosa/Lilial/ethyl linalool a fresh watery-muguet floralcy; lemon + Cyclal C + Helional a green-citrus top; Iso E Super a woody backbone.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Vanilla Bean Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Rich sweet vanilla bean: creamy-boozy vanilla (vanillin/ethyl vanillin) with a caramel-cotton-candy lift and a soft spicy-clove nuance.
formulas.what_it_does: Ethyl vanillin + vanillin are the vanilla core (ethyl vanillin ~3x stronger/more chocolatey); Ethyl maltol adds caramel/cotton-candy sweetness; Methyl diantilis a clove-vanilla spice; Hedione lifts and prevents it going flat. ~36% PG.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Violet Key Accord

ingredients.note: name printed at end of PDF; matches 27.312 row

formulas.smells_like: Powdery violet: the classic ionone violet-candy powder (alpha/beta ionone dominant) with a green violet-leaf top and a soft woody-heliotrope base.
formulas.what_it_does: Alpha + beta ionone + Isoraldeine (methyl ionone) together (~45%) are the violet-powder core; Violet leaf absolute + methyl octine carbonate a green cucumber-leaf top; Heliotropine/anisic aldehyde powdery almond sweetness; Sandela/amyris a soft woody base. ~25% benzyl benzoate.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: White Grapefruit (Citrus) Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Zesty white grapefruit: sparkling bitter-fresh citrus (orange terpenes/citral) with a green petitgrain edge and a clean airy floral-musk drydown.
formulas.what_it_does: Orange terpenes form the bulk citrus body (~77%); Citral + dihydro myrcenol give the sharp grapefruit-lemon zest; Dimethyl octenone a characteristic grapefruit-peel facet; Hedione/Velvione a light floral-musk base.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: White Musk Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Clean soft white musk: a smooth laundry-clean, slightly sweet-powdery musk with a subtle warm skin-like roundness.
formulas.what_it_does: Ethylene brassylate + Galaxolide are the clean laundry-musk core; Exaltolide + Ambrettolide (macrocyclic musks) add a natural warm-skin roundness; Velvione a soft fruity-musky lift. A simple 5-material teaching musk base.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Ylang Key Accord
formulas.smells_like: Heady tropical ylang-ylang: banana-jasmine-floral richness (benzyl acetate/linalool) with a narcotic cresol-medicinal edge and a spicy-balsamic warmth.
formulas.what_it_does: Benzyl acetate + Linalool + Geraniol are the floral backbone; Para-cresyl methyl ether + para-cresyl acetate give ylang's characteristic narcotic-medicinal cresol top; Cinnamyl/benzyl cinnamate + dihydro eugenol a spicy-balsamic body.
formulas.provenance: Perfumer's Apprentice (Givaudan/IFF educational Key Accord PDFs)

formulas.name: Forest Woods Harmony (IFF Accord 14050, feat. Karmawood)

ingredients.note: featured woody-amber-sandalwood material (0 in the base version)
solvent (3.4 in base version, 0 in +Karmawood version)

formulas.smells_like: A green, spicy, balsamic woody harmony on a Timbersilk/Virginia-cedar base; Karmawood adds a creamy sandalwood-amber, powdery facet with more strength and tenacity.
formulas.what_it_does: Timbersilk (65) + Virginia cedar (22) form the woods; hexenyl salicylate greens the top and nutmeg spices it; Karmawood reinforces the woody-amber-sandalwood base. IFF demo showing Karmawood added (replacing DPG diluent).
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Balsamic Woods & Spiced Florals (IFF Accord 14051, feat. Karmawood)

ingredients.note: featured woody-amber material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: Balsamic woods with spiced florals: benzyl-benzoate/hexyl-cinnamal floralcy, clove-cinnamon spice, musky Galaxolide and a vanillic-coumarinic sweet powdery drydown.
formulas.what_it_does: Benzyl benzoate (48) + Timbersilk + Galaxolide form the woody-musky body; a spice complex (eugenol, cinnamics) and floral aldehydes give the spiced-floral character; Karmawood deepens the creamy woody base.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Polished Leather (IFF Accord 14052, feat. Karmawood)

ingredients.note: featured woody-amber material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A smooth polished leather: ambery-woody (Cedramber, Cashmeran, Trimofix) and musky (Applelide, Zenolide) with a clary-sage lift and a mossy Veramoss touch.
formulas.what_it_does: Timbersilk (26) + Applelide musk (24) + amber materials build a refined leathery-woody drydown; Karmawood adds substantivity and a creamy woody core.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Blooming Lavender (IFF Accord 14056, feat. Karmawood)

ingredients.note: featured woody material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A fresh blooming lavender-fougere: aromatic lavandin/dihydromyrcenol over salicylate woods, coumarin sweetness and a green mossy isobutyl-quinoline edge.
formulas.what_it_does: Kohinool (30) + salicylates + Vertenex woods with lavandin, dihydromyrcenol and coumarin give the classic fougere shape; Karmawood reinforces the woody base and durability.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Delicate Bouquet (IFF Accord 14062, feat. Karmawood)

ingredients.note: featured woody material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A soft clean floral bouquet: citrus lift, Kharismal floralcy and gingery spice on a creamy Timbersilk/ethylene-brassylate musk base.
formulas.what_it_does: Timbersilk (35) + ethylene brassylate musk (18.6) form the base; citrus top and Kharismal floral heart; Karmawood (0.7) rounds and warms the woods.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Herbal Fruity Floral (IFF Accord 14057, feat. Bergamal)

ingredients.note: featured aldehydic citrus material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A fresh herbal-fruity floral: dihydromyrcenol/linalool freshness, green-fruity accents and a soft musky-woody drydown; Bergamal adds a bright aldehydic lemon/verbena lift.
formulas.what_it_does: Dihydro myrcenol (39) dominates with fruity-green materials over a Vertofix/Timbersilk woody base; Bergamal adds the aldehydic citrus top.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Lemon Zeste (IFF Accord 14059, feat. Bergamal)

ingredients.note: featured citrus material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A sparkling lemon-citrus zest with a big fatty-aldehyde top and a rosy geraniol/citronellol heart; Bergamal boosts the aldehydic lemon brightness.
formulas.what_it_does: d-Limonene (23) + Citronellol (17) + Linalool (14) with a strong C8-C12 aldehyde complex for lift; Bergamal sharpens the citrus top.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Mandarin Burst (IFF Accord 14063, feat. Bergamal)

ingredients.note: featured citrus material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A juicy mandarin/citrus burst: distilled citrus and citral over a big dihydromyrcenol freshness, with green-fruity and slightly minty facets and a light musk base.
formulas.what_it_does: Dihydro myrcenol (26) + Citrus oil distilled (10) with citral and aldehydes; Bergamal adds an aldehydic citrus sparkle. ~29% DPG.
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: Bergamal Encap fruity-floral (IFF Accord 14066)

ingredients.note: featured citrus material (0 in base version)

formulas.smells_like: A fruity-floral citrus for encapsulation: apple/pear fruity notes (Nectarate, Verdox, Manzanate), ionone-violet woodiness and a citrus-floral top; Bergamal gives a strong aldehydic citrus lift.
formulas.what_it_does: Verdox (15.6) + Nectarate (15) + ionones over an ethylene-brassylate/Timbersilk musk base; Bergamal (7.5) delivers a pronounced citrus top designed to survive encapsulation (in IPM, not alcohol).
formulas.provenance: IFF demonstration formulas hosted by Pell Wall (via Wayback Machine)

formulas.name: DIY Eau de Cologne (4711 / Aqua Mirabilis style)
formulas.smells_like: Classic fresh citrus eau de cologne, close to a 4711-type Aqua Mirabilis.
formulas.what_it_does: Bright citrus top (bergamot/lemon/grapefruit) over an orange-blossom heart, fixed by benzoin + sandalwood. Parts are drops; dissolve in 50ml perfumer's alcohol and mature ~30 days.
formulas.provenance: Ayala Moriel Parfums (SmellyBlog) DIY tutorial

formulas.name: Amber Accord (Aftel, Essence & Alchemy)
formulas.smells_like: Rich, dark, sticky-sweet like toffee/caramel, with a faint leathery labdanum edge keeping it 'not quite edible'.
formulas.what_it_does: The classic oriental/amber base triangle: benzoin gives sweet balsamic body, labdanum leathery warmth, vanilla rounds it; used to fix volatile florals. Book-attributed to Mandy Aftel.
formulas.provenance: I Dream of Perfume blog (Aftel 'Essence & Alchemy')

formulas.name: Vanilla Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: A comforting, rich vanilla with a sweet herbal feel from liatris and natural resins, balanced by a hint of bright orange.
formulas.what_it_does: Layers three vanilla types with balsams/resins for depth; musks and Javanol sandalwood extend it; ethyl maltol/coumarin add gourmand sweetness. ~46% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Aquatic Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: A fresh seashore effect: Calone gives an intense marine/ozone note over an airy Hedione floralcy.
formulas.what_it_does: Hedione-dominant floral heart with the Calone marine signature over musks and light woods; a versatile aquatic foundation.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Champagne Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: A fizzy, fruity accord evoking sparkling champagne with narcotic sweetness.
formulas.what_it_does: Fructone sugary base plus damascone's grape/yeast facet and aldehyde C-12 fuzz simulate the fizz; frangipani gives the narcotic top. ~58% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Gasoline Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: Captures gasoline's polarizing petrol character via green materials, phenolics and hydrocarbon-evoking aromatics.
formulas.what_it_does: Spirodecane provides the fuel-like core; greens (violet leaf, hexenol, octenol) and phenolics build the petrol impression; resins add smoky depth. ~97% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Pumpkin Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: A reimagined pumpkin-pie accord: earthy and gourmand, made realistic with unusual vegetal ingredients (spinach, artichoke, porcini) and roasted/caramel notes.
formulas.what_it_does: HomoFuranol + furfural give roasted/caramel body; vanillin/coumarin add pie sweetness; vegetal absolutes add authentic squash realism. ~69% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Earth Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: Predominantly woody (~77%) with spicy, green, terpenic, floral and musky facets evoking earth and forest floor.
formulas.what_it_does: Iso E Super + cedar dominate a dry woody base; greens/camphor on top and mate absolute in the heart add damp-earth realism. ~98% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Solar Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: Floral-forward with citrus, marine and aldehydic facets, evoking a warm sunny 'solar' effect (salicylates give the sunscreen note).
formulas.what_it_does: Salicylates + helional create the solar/sunscreen impression; aldehydes and citrus give sparkle; Calone/Ozofleur add marine air; ambers fix the base. 100% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Cola Accord (Olfactorian community)
formulas.smells_like: The iconic fizzy sweet cola drink: warm, sweet, syrupy, full and rounded.
formulas.what_it_does: Vanilla + spices + citrus form the cola identity; the fizz comes from menthol, benzaldehyde and allyl amyl glycolate with white grapefruit; resins/balsams give syrupy body. 100% concentrate.
formulas.provenance: Olfactorian.com (community/enthusiast formula database)

formulas.name: Chocolate Accord (Bedoukian demo)
formulas.smells_like: A realistic dark chocolate / cocoa accord: roasted, nutty, caramellic and sweet.
formulas.what_it_does: Roasted pyrazines + furfural give the cocoa/roasted core; vanillin/maltol/furaneol supply sweetness; lactones add creaminess. Bedoukian demo; verified on the source page (benzaldehyde 0.80, isobutyraldehyde 8.00, DIPG 533.80).
formulas.provenance: The Good Scents Company demo formulas (Bedoukian/other)

formulas.name: Vanilla 10 (fragrance demo formula)
formulas.smells_like: A simple sweet vanilla with balsamic and powdery facets.
formulas.what_it_does: Vanillin over a benzyl benzoate carrier gives a soft vanilla; heliotropin/anisaldehyde add powder; Peru balsam and maltol add balsamic-caramel warmth; citral/orange lift the top.
formulas.provenance: The Good Scents Company demo formulas (Bedoukian/other)

formulas.name: Imagination (tipo) — Louis Vuitton
formulas.smells_like: Louis Vuitton — Imagination (tipo/clone): abertura cítrica fresca (bergamota FCF, laranja) com gengibre picante; fundo âmbar-amadeirado-almiscarado (chá preto, Ambroxan, guaiacwood, almíscares).
formulas.what_it_does: Clone 'tipo Imagination'. Valores em partes por mil (somam ~1000). Traços que aparecem como 0 na imagem (aldeído cinâmico, indol, nerol) entram como ~0,3. A fórmula original do Creative Formulas tem 46 ingredientes; esta é a versão de ~23 mostrada no vídeo do canal PerfumoLogos.  CORREÇÃO 20/09/2026: a transcrição do vídeo perdeu a coluna de diluição — 36 das 64 fórmulas deste arquivo a declaram, esta estava com tudo em null. Três linhas são impossíveis como material puro, porque passariam da dose máxima do próprio material: Ambrox Super daria 21,7% (máx 10), Dihidro Beta Ionona 9,8% (máx 1) e Bergamota 7,6% (máx 5). Lidas como solução a 10% as três caem exatamente dentro da faixa — 2,17%, 0,98% e 0,76%. As outras 20 linhas cabem como puras, então NÃO são diluição: se tudo fosse a 10%, o concentrado seria 90% solvente e um EDP a 20% não fecharia.
formulas.confidence: partial (diluição das 3 linhas inferida pela dose, não lida da fonte)
formulas.provenance: Fórmula 'Imagination Type' da Creative Formulas (creative-formulas.com, R$200), reproduzida no vídeo do canal PerfumoLogos (Victor Lopes).
